output_text:
import os
import requests

def batch_translate(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    api_key = config.get("api_key") or os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("Missing OpenAI API key")
    source_language = config.get("source_language", "auto")
    target_language = config.get("target_language", "en")
    model = config.get("model", "gpt-4o-mini")
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    text_block = "\n".join(f"{i}\t{text}" for i, text in enumerate(payload))
    prompt = (
        f"Translate the following lines from {source_language} to {target_language}. "
        "Return only the translated lines in the same order, one per line, preserving line count and order.\n"
        f"{text_block}"
    )
    response = requests.post(
        "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions",
        headers=headers,
        json={
            "model": model,
            "messages": [
                {"role": "system", "content": "You are a translation engine."},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt},
            ],
            "temperature": 0,
        },
        timeout=config.get("timeout", 60),
    )
    response.raise_for_status()
    content = response.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
    translated_lines = [line.split("\t", 1)[-1] for line in content.strip().splitlines()]
    result = translated_lines[: len(payload)]
    return result
